fields.body_md:
## About this programme

The Full Time MBA (Master of Business Administration) at Leeds University Business School is a one-year, full-time course. It runs on campus in Leeds and starts in September 2027. You study in English.

The programme is accredited by AMBA, the Association of MBAs. Leeds University Business School also has triple accreditation from AACSB, AMBA and EQUIS.

**The most important thing for an Indian applicant:** Leeds asks for more than three years of postgraduate work experience before you apply. Check this first.

The 2026/27 course catalogue lists 12 compulsory modules. Each is worth 15 credits, so the programme totals 180 credits:

- Management Decision Making
- International Business Management
- Creative and Innovative Thinking and Practice
- Analytical Thinking and Data Management
- Strategic and Entrepreneurial Management
- Economics of Strategy
- Global Marketing Management
- People and Behaviour in Organizations
- Global Operations and Information Management
- Leading in Practice
- Strategic HRM and Talent Management
- Accounting and Finance

You also take part in Live Business Challenges, where teams work with industry professionals. On the International Study Tour, you work on a real consultancy project with an international organisation.

## Can you get in?

| Requirement | What Leeds asks for |
|---|---|
| Degree | A good bachelor's degree, equal to a UK 2:1 honours degree, or an acceptable professional qualification |
| Indian degree | To meet a 2:1, Leeds' India page lists first class (60%) or a CGPA of 6/10, 5/8, 4.2/7 or 3/4 |
| Work experience | More than three years of postgraduate work experience before you apply |
| GMAT | Not mandatory in most cases. Leeds may ask for GMAT Focus with a minimum score of 555 if your degree is below a 2:1, or if you have no formal or professional qualification |
| English | IELTS 6.5 overall, with no less than 6.0 in each section |
| Interview | Mandatory. Only one interview attempt is offered |

**GMAT** is the Graduate Management Admission Test, a test for business school entry. **IELTS** is an English language test. If you already hold a qualification that proves your English, check the list of tests below first.

Leeds also accepts these English tests:

| Test | Minimum score |
|---|---|
| PTE Academic | 64, with at least 60 in each skill. PTE online is not accepted |
| Cambridge Advanced (CAE) | Grade C or above |
| TOEFL iBT | 88, with 19 in listening, 20 in reading, 22 in speaking and 21 in writing. The Home Edition is not accepted |
| LanguageCert Academic | 70, with 65 in each skill. Online tests are not accepted |

## What it costs

Tuition is **£41,200**. This is the total for the course, not a yearly fee. The same total applies to UK and international students.

Here is a worked first-year total. The programme lasts one year, so the total below covers the whole course.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition: total for the course | £41,200 |
| Visa money: £1,171 a month for 9 months (£1,171 × 9 = £10,539) | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge: £776 for each year of your visa | £776 or more |
| **Total** | **at least £53,073** |

The arithmetic is £41,200 + £10,539 + £558 + £776 = £53,073.

The £1,171 figure applies to studying outside London, and Leeds is outside London. The visa money is proof of funds. You show it to the Home Office. It is not a fee to Leeds. You must have had enough money for 28 days in a row, and the last day of that period must be within 31 days of the day you apply. The [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide) explains the full process.

**Deposit.** A deposit is a payment you make in advance, and it is taken off your tuition. The £2,000 deposit is a general taught-masters rule. It does not name the MBA. Taught postgraduate applicants who need a Student visa pay it after an unconditional offer, and before they receive a CAS. A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the document Leeds issues so you can apply for your visa. The deadline for this deposit for taught postgraduate applicants is 20 August 2027.

**Your visa is longer than your course.** You usually pay the health surcharge for more than one year. A 16-month visa costs £1,164. That is £776 for the first year, plus half of £776 (£388) for the rest of the visa.

For a wider comparison, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

The MBA Excellence Scholarships are the scholarship for this programme. The award is a tuition fee deduction. Leeds does not give one fixed amount. All applicants are considered automatically. Leeds judges applicants on career achievement, academic record and leadership, with community values. It assesses you from your application form and your interview. Leeds lists the final deadline as ongoing. Questions go to mba@lubs.leeds.ac.uk.

Two Masters scholarships do not cover the MBA. The Masters International Excellence Scholarship excludes the MBA. The Masters International Regional Scholarship, which gives a £6,000 fee reduction to passport holders from India and other listed countries, also excludes it.

For more on fees and funding at Leeds, see our [University of Leeds page](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-leeds).

## Deadlines and intakes

Start: September 2027.

| Intake | Who applies | Apply by |
|---|---|---|
| September 2027 | International applicants | 31 July 2027 |
| September 2027 | UK applicants | 14 August 2027 |

Any conditions on your offer must be met by 6 August 2027, 23:59 UK time. The interview takes place before a conditional offer, so plan for it early.

Apply early for your visa. The earliest you can apply for a Student visa is 6 months before your course starts.

## How to apply

1. Check the entry rules above. Look at your degree, your work experience, your English test and whether you may need a GMAT score.
2. Apply online through the University of Leeds Applicant Portal. This is the only application route. For questions, email mba@lubs.leeds.ac.uk.
3. Gather your documents:
   - a completed application form
   - an up-to-date CV that shows your work experience
   - original transcripts and certificates, with certified translations if they are not in English
   - evidence of your English test, which you can send before you take the test
   - a copy of your passport, showing the number and expiry date
   - your UK visa history, if you have one
   - your GMAT score report, if you have taken the test
4. Write a personal statement of no more than 200 words. It answers three questions: a fun fact about you, a lecture topic for MBA students, and your greatest career achievement.
5. Ask for two references: one academic and one from an employer.
6. Attend the interview. It is mandatory, and only one attempt is offered.

## After the programme

A dedicated MBA Careers Coach supports you while you study and for three years after you graduate.

The Graduate visa lets you stay and work in the UK after your course. It lasts 2 years if you apply on or before 31 December 2026. It lasts 18 months if you apply from 1 January 2027. Your course starts in September 2027, so the 18-month rule applies to you. The application fee is £937. Leeds must tell the Home Office that you completed your course. The [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide) covers the Student visa route and what follows it.

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if:**

- You have more than three years of postgraduate work experience.
- Your degree meets Leeds' 2:1 standard.
- You want a one-year, full-time MBA in Leeds with AMBA accreditation.
- You can pay the £41,200 total and show the visa money.
- You can attend an interview.

**Think carefully if:**

- You have less than three years of postgraduate work experience.
- Your degree is below a 2:1. Leeds may ask for a GMAT Focus score of at least 555.
- You need a scholarship to afford the course. The MBA Excellence award is a variable tuition fee deduction, and the Masters scholarships do not cover the MBA.

faq_json.q: Does the Leeds Full Time MBA need a GMAT score?
faq_json.a: Not in most cases. Leeds says a GMAT score is not mandatory in most cases. It may ask for GMAT Focus with a minimum score of 555 if your degree is below a 2:1, or if you have no formal or professional qualification. Send your score if you have taken the test.

faq_json.q: What is the total cost of the Leeds Full Time MBA for Indian students?
faq_json.a: International tuition is £41,200, which is the total for the whole course. With visa money of £10,539 (£1,171 a month for 9 months), the £558 visa fee and the £776 health surcharge, the first-year total is at least £53,073.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for the Leeds MBA starting September 2027?
faq_json.a: International applicants should apply by 31 July 2027. UK applicants should apply by 14 August 2027. Any conditions on your offer must be met by 6 August 2027, 23:59 UK time.

faq_json.q: Is the interview for the Leeds MBA optional?
faq_json.a: No. The interview is mandatory, and only one attempt is offered. It takes place before a conditional offer.

faq_json.q: How much work experience do I need for the Leeds MBA?
faq_json.a: Leeds asks for more than three years of postgraduate work experience before you apply. Check this before you start your application.
